# Submariners' Advocacy Group (SAG)

> Nonprofit organization founded by U.S. Navy Submariners in April 2024 to advocate for the health, recognition, and care of all U.S. Navy Submariners through scientific research, public education, and legislative advocacy. Tagline: Submariners Helping Submariners.

## Who SAG serves
- Every person who qualified in U.S. Navy submarines and earned the Dolphins: veterans, active duty, retirees, and their families and survivors
- There are no applications, dues, or eligibility requirements beyond having qualified in submarines

## What SAG does
- Advocates for legislation and policy that improve healthcare, benefits, and recognition for Submariners
- Supports research into submarine atmospheric contaminants and other occupational exposures, including a nationwide Submariner registry
- Educates veterans, families, healthcare providers, Veteran Service Officers, and policymakers
- Publishes The Unseen Burden: Toxic Exposures and Health Impacts on U.S. Navy Submariners, with Amendment 1 (Physiological Effects) and Amendment 2 (Compounded Stressors)
